query:
SELECT v.unit_id, v.position::text as "position!"
        FROM vote v
        JOIN resolution r ON r.id = v.resolution_id
        JOIN general_meeting gm ON gm.id = r.meeting_id
        WHERE v.resolution_id = $1
          AND r.meeting_id = $2
          AND gm.building_id = $3
        ORDER BY v.unit_id
